task:
Dear <Ranger>, planet <ToPlanet> of the <ToStar> system is a place where villains of various races have been deported for as long as anyone can remember. They and their more or less acculturated descendants live there on a small plot of the developed land. This is an inter-race community, a dream of the Galaxy Council. 

Planet <ToPlanet> has not yet been included in the list of the inhabited planets. Recently rich deposits of uranium ores have been found there, and we want to establish our control over them. You can help us with that. In order to do this you must register as a presidential candidate on the planet no later than <Date>. After winning the elections, you will relegate your authority to our representative, since the constitution of the <ToPlanet> allows it. You reward for this will be <Money> cr. 

Do we have a deal?
success: Good job, <Ranger>! The import of cheap uranium from <ToPlanet> is already in full swing. We have managed to save more than 1.000.000 cr on that! And all thanks to you! So, you've earned your reward of <Money> cr honestly. The money has been transferred to your account.

As soon as the election results appeared on the board, an armed security guard shot down Abu Linkoln Husseyn from a blaster. The body of your unfortunate rival was carried out of the hall, and you were officially proclaimed President of the planet <ToPlanet>. After long congratulations and much banquet drinking, you were taken to the official representation office of the <FromPlanet> planet. 

- Nice job, <Ranger>! - Kill Young told you. - But you have to go through yet another tiny formality. Please, sign this document here - and here. It relegates the presidential authority of the <ToPlanet> planet to me.

Pleasantly smiling the Peleng handed you a golden pen.
loc.11.0:
- This is some kind of mistake! - you shouted, seeing that an armed security guard is approaching you. - The election must have been rigged!

These words seemed to be your last...
loc.12.0: You are in the election headquarters. This morning, <CurDate>, is day [p7] of the election campaign. You can spend the morning speaking to the reporters or go canvassing. What would you prefer?
loc.12.1: Today <CurDate>, is day [p7] of the election campaign. The whole resources of the election headquarters are all at your command. Usually in the morning we conduct press conferences and work with journalists. You can also partake in canvassing in the streets. So, what will you do in the morning?
loc.12.2: Today <CurDate>, is day [p7] of the election campaign. You count how many days are left. Looks like {[p25]-[p7]}. We must use this time to our best advantage. Usually we hold press conferences in the morning. And, you can also advertise yourself. So, what will you do?
loc.12.9:
The election campaign is over! Today is the election day!

Canvassing is prohibited today, so you have nothing more to do than to enjoy your time and anticipate the show which is called <clr>"Vote Count"<clrEnd>. Before you were leaving, Kill Young brought you the latest opinion survey.
loc.13.0:
Two seriously looking Pelengs met you in a small spaceport of the <ToPlanet> planet. The first introduced himself as Kill Young, official representative of the <FromPlanet>, the second one turned out to be his assistant called Strangl Lee. 

- You arrived just in time! - Kill Young exclaimed, shaking your hand with all four of his. - We have already prepared all the documents for your registration, the only thing left is to execute them.

Within several minutes, you find yourself in a suite of the planet's best hotel scrawling your signature on all the required documents, other 30 minutes later a beaming Kill Young formally presents you with a document certifying you as an official presidential candidate of <ToPlanet>.

- Congratulations, <Ranger>! The election campaign begins tomorrow. Naturally, all the cost is covered by <FromPlanet>, so you don't even have to bother yourself with the cost. Your presidential rival is a Human called <clr> Abu Linkoln Husseyn<clrEnd>. The election will take place in [p25] days. If you have no questions, then let me and Stangl Lee wish you good night. A car will be sent for you tomorrow, it will take you to the campaign headquarters.
loc.20.0: - Were you not aware of this? - the Peleng said in amazement. - In order to avoid a scandal, accusations of rigging the election and gerrymandering, civil wars and other outbreaks of discontent on behalf of the defeated candidates, they will be immediately be executed upon losing the election. It was Linch, the first president of <ToPlanet>, who introduced this law, and we hold firm to it ever since. You have nothing to fear, you've come here to win, haven't you?
loc.21.0: Neglecting all arguments of the Pelengs, you head for the spaceport. You failed your mission, but saved your life!
loc.22.0:
Breakfast was served into your room that morning. After the breakfast a luxurious car took you to a high building of the official representation office of the <FromPlanet> planet, where your election headquarters were located. Kill Young met you in the HQ.

- Fist of all, we must draw out a plan of the <clr>election process<clrEnd> for you. This will take us the whole day. The experts are already waiting for you. And tomorrow you may start your election campaign, as you see fit.
loc.23.0:
Taking advantage of everyone's being busy, you stealthily left the building and ran headlong to the spaceport.

You failed your mission, but saved your life!
loc.24.0:
- Fine, <Ranger>! - the Peleng encouraged you, as soon as he saw your signature on the document. - You're a nice guy! And therefore you will not be just allowed to leave this planet alive, you will get a reward of <Money> cr. It is waiting for you on the <FromPlanet> planet.

30 minutes later you were sitting in your spaceship.
loc.25.0:
Having heard this, the Pelengs looked at each other.

- This is the third time already, - Strangle Lee uttered listlessly, taking a crossbow out of the pocket, which is by the way Pelengs' favourite weapon. - Can these dumb rangers really be thinking that we spend so much dough for their election campaign only that they be governing the planet by themselves?! 

A needle pricked into your foot, and you lost your conscience. You recovered in a dismal dungeon that was equipped with various instruments of torture. Within several days of torture they made you sign all the required documents, and after this they shot you down out of mercy with the help of a blaster...
loc.26.0:
You requested price lists from all the neighbourhood's liquor stores and plunged into a review of these documents for a considerable amount of time, checking whether the quality of the products matches the prices listed. A day passed unnoticed while your were indulging yourself in this useful occupation.

So, day [p7] of the election campaign is over! You are in your hotel room. Are you interested in the events that happened in the world today?
loc.26.1: So, day [p7] of the election campaign is over! You are in your hotel room. Are you interested in the events that happened in the world today?
loc.26.2:
It was either your image-makers that underpaid the dirty reporter or he was initially sent by Abu Linkoln Husseyn's guys from his election headquarters... In any case, during the prime-time the stereovision aired not the discrediting material that your ordered for Husseyn but a video spot with you voicing your order shot by that reporter with the help of a spycam. The comments to the spot described in details all the ugliness of the dirty methods that you employed, therefore now even the dumbest of the spectators would have no doubts in your meanness and creepiness...

Within an hour a motley mob gathered in front of your windows and was unanimously yelling curses. Your security and image-makers strongly recommended you to cancel all the events for today, and you did exactly as they told you. The rally in front of your windows ended only later in the night. 

Well, how many votes have you lost today? Too many! You swore you would never use the methods of black PR again.

Well, day [p7] of the election campaign is over! You are in your hotel room. Are you interested in the events that happened in the world today?
loc.27.0:
You took taken a black piece of paper and wrote: "Lunch Menu". You surrounded yourself with cooking books and plunged into a profound gastronomic survey. By lunch time this document of paramount importance was completed!

You had a good lunch, and were ready to attack your election campaign issues with regained strength. What will we do this afternoon? You can have a campaign ad shot or visit a public event.
loc.27.1:
You ordered the dirty reporter to blacken Abu Linkoln Husseyn before the <clr>Gaals<clrEnd>. Having settled down different details with you and your assistants, the dirty reporter left. You were sitting in anticipation of the results of his work. The dirty reporter telephoned you after lunch and announced that your order had been accomplished and you could watch the results on the stereovision system right now. 

The <clr>"Spiritual essence of the iike-baana"<clrEnd> program, which is Gaals' favourite, was dedicated completely to the coverage of a disgusting scene that happened to Abu Linkoln Husseyn several years ago. After bousing with a mixture of vtequila, kinza and beer this Human got beastly drunk and went to the iike-baana exhibition. He started brawling there, broke two iike-baanas and vomited on the third one. The spot was illustrated with the evidences of those who had witnessed the accident. And though you knew very well that all the details were fake, everything looked very convincing. And the zoomed-in sight of the iike-baana, which was vomited upon, could not leave any Gaal unimpressed. Now it was obvious who they would give their votes for.

The members of other races, who were indifferent towards iike-baanas, reacted rather apathetically. And someone from the Maloqs who despised all arts, and especially gaals, found the program rather amusing and the actions of your rival very sharp-witted. But the uncultured members of that dumb race may not be taken into account anyway. 

You switched off the stereovision system in a much better mood. Well, that's how professionals work! So, what will we do in the afternoon?
loc.27.2:
When you asked the dirty reporter to discredit Abu Linkoln Husseyn before the <clr>Maloqs<clrEnd>, he assured you that nothing was easier, and that everything would be completed within a couple of hours, so that you would not by chance miss the airing of the discrediting material.

Just before lunch, the <clr>"Attention, sailor boys!!!"<clrEnd> stereoprogram, which is Maloqs' favourite, instead of airing a scheduled analysis of new guard regulations showed a smashing story about your rival. It turned out that in his youth he dodged the military service for three years! He bribed the doctors at medical examination stations and forged deferment documents. And when he finally was drafted, he showed himself a sniveller and a sissy. He could not even dismantle a grenade launcher and then put it together again within the required time frame. According to the reports of his unit's officers, Abu Linkoln Husseyn had never learned how to obey the commands such as "Dismissed" or "Eyes on the commander". And his service ended in a most dishonorable desertion, when he cowardly fled from his home planet in a cargobay of a trading craft...

Yes, after such a smashing stereovision program your rival will find it hard to win back the support of the Maloqs! Although there were some Pelengs and Humans who saw the program and found the actions of Abu Linkoln Husseyn quite reasonable and natural, these individuals were very few in number. 

You switched off the stereovision system in a much better mood and went for lunch. It seemed that the day had a good start! Well, what will we do in the afternoon?
loc.27.3:
At first the dirty reporter refused to perform the mission of blackening Abu Linkoln Husseyn - a human - in front of <clr>humans <clrEnd> as almost impossible. Long blandishments and a promise of doubling the fee, which was voiced by your assistant, made him reluctantly get on the stick. You got so tired of talking to him that you decided to have a rest before lunch. After lunch they brought you the latest issue of the <clr>"Human Truth"<clrEnd> newspaper, almost half of which was dedicated to reporter's investigation titled <clr>"Who is Abu Linkoln Husseyn?"<clrEnd>.

It turned out that Abu Linkoln Husseyn was an active member of the Mega-Masochists & Misanthropes sect!!! Members of this human sect honestly regarded humans as the inferior race and made everything in their power to have the humanity enslaved by other races. The evidence, trumped up by the dirty reporter, was very convincing, it included testimony of witnesses, recollections of beholders, opinions of the mediums, banking accounts and diffused and blurred pictures made with the help of an amateur spycam. The implication of your rival in a series of huge acts of terrorism performed by the sect on several human planets was beyond all doubt. Besides, now it was clear why Abu Linkoln Husseyn became a presidential candidate, and there were little doubts concerning the fate of <ToPlanet>'s human population in case he wins the elections.

It was quite natural that all the normal humans should sincerely hate the members of the Mega-Masochists & Misanthropes sect, so that now it would be very hard for Abu Linkoln Husseyn to gain back the goodwill of the Humans. The attitude towards your rival of other race members, who read the article occasionally, somewhat improved, but these were few.	

You put aside the paper in a much better mood. Now you can get down to work. Well, what will you this afternoon?
loc.27.4:
You tasked the dirty reporter to blacken Abu Linkoln Husseyn in the eyes of the Pelengs. Having received a solid advance payment from your assistant Kill Young the dirty reporter left. You decided that you worked enough for this morning, and took a nap on the sofa till lunch time. After lunch, you switched on the stereovision and saw the results of your order on the screen. 

<clr>"The Law and How to Dodge It"<clrEnd> stereoprogram adored by the Pelengs had a new section today, called <clr>"Beware: the Informer!"<clrEnd>. Today it was devoted to you your rival. It turned out that Abu Linkoln Husseyn had been a paid informer of Gaals, Faes and Human intelligence agencies!!! Getting into confidence of honest Peleng drug dealers and pirates, he subsequently treacherously disclosed their plans to the intelligence agencies. It was he who informed the Humans about the location of lyakusha Borzukhan secret base on one of the uninhabited planets. It was Abu Linkoln Husseyn who caught and extradited to the Gaals three fearless Dzukhallag agents, who tried to steal from the Gaals the designs of their top-secret device called Jumper. Moreover, Abu Linkoln Husseyn was outlawed on {[14..19]} Peleng planets. In conclusion, the host recommended all respectable Pelengs to stay away from this guy. 

You switched off the stereovision system in a much better mood. You can consider the votes of the Pelengs to be in your pocket, for they regard informants as the most grievous criminals! The journalist trumped up all the material discrediting Abu Linkoln Husseyn from the very start, but your rival will never be in a position to prove that. Although the members of other races found the portrait of Abu Linkoln Husseyn shown in the program much to their liking, the black PR was nevertheless a good investment.

So what will you do this afternoon?
loc.27.5:
- You can do whatever you like, but make it so than none of the highbrowed <clr>Faes<clrEnd> vote for Husseyn! - this was a mission you assigned to the dirty reporter, and Kill Young confirmed your words by an impressive-looking envelop with his pay. 

The talk with the dirty reporter soured your spirits and you decided to have a rest before lunch, after which they brought you a copy of the <clr>Scientific Report<clrEnd> Magazine that is very popular among the Faes. Its editorial was devoted to an article called <clr>Is This Our Future President?!<clrEnd>

The article covered the student years of Abu Linkoln Husseyn that he spent in the elite Aipentack University. The facts disclosed were simply killing for all the Faes - it turned out that Abu Linkoln Husseyn was cribbing homeworks and tests!!! Being caught on the exam with a crib note, he tried to bribe the president of the university, and on this occasion caused the migraine of the respected dalani. And during the thesis defence he was condemned in trying to steal others' results and was expelled from the university with disgrace! False photos, pseudo-copies of exam protocols and fictional interviews with the university academics, accompanied all the material. 

The material was so well documented that on the same day a crowd of agitated Faes bombarded the election headquarters of Abu Linkoln Husseyn with neon lamps with expired service life. As for the other races, they didn't seem to be that influenced by the article, for they were not reading the Scientific Report, and they just heard something about the article from second sources. Anyway, many Gaals shared the agitation of the Faes, but all the rest found the conduct of your rival during his student years to be quite normal or even exemplary.

In general you were pleased by the black PR and its effectiveness. Now, you may employ more politically correct methods of election campaigning. So what will you do in the afternoon?
loc.27.6: You had a good lunch and were ready to plunge into your election campaign with renewed strength. The journalists usually take rest after lunch, but you can contact your voters directly. Or you can order a new ad to be shot for you. Well, what will you do in the afternoon?
loc.27.7: As long as you remained undecided you lost precious time. Well, it's already late to go canvassing among the people, but you can still manage to have an ad shot. Or do you prefer to take a rest instead?
loc.27.8: So what would you like to do?

- Old Gink, <clr>Young Generation<clrEnd> Magazine. Please, tell us why you have become a ranger?
loc.29.0:

loc.29.2:

You spoke about yourself and your feasts in the struggle with the Dominators for a long time, but judging by the dull faces of the attending reporters, it could be seriously doubted that your speech would ever reach your voters.

loc.32.0:
A Gaalian journalist took the floor.

- Professor Noo Pasaran, <clr>Interracial Relations Ethics<clrEnd> Almanac. My question is this. Imagine that your spaceship suffered a wreck on an uninhabited planet with a representative of each rational race of the Galaxy on board. Rescue team will not arrive soon. Please tell us whom will you eat first in these circumstances?
loc.34.0:
A Peleng was the fastest to react:

- Zap Katze, <clr>Lump of Mud<clrEnd> newspaper. Imagine that you are testing a Maloq Bumblebee fighter. A crazy maintenance robot armed with a photon cutter is approaching you up front. You decide to shoot the robot from the weapons, but due to a malfunctioning of the aiming device all the shots are missing the target. After that you wish to disappear in the clouds, but the drift-up lever is wedged. You try to take the robot under your control using a hacker code that you know, but you see that the batteries of the transmitter are down. And the robot is almost near!!! In despair you push the catapult button, and a sign appears blinking on the panel: "This action will lead to the irretrievable loss of the combat vehicle. It is allowable only in emergency situations. Please enter you identification code for the authorization, then your personal keyword and the emergency situation code." Now what would you say about your commanders after all this?
loc.35.0:
One of the Gaals managed to get the floor before his colleagues.

- Shooch Yaa, <clr>Spiritual Essence of the Iike-Baana<clrEnd> stereoprogram. Tell me, what is your favourite color?
loc.36.0:
Kill Young looked at you with a shade of doubt on his face.

- Black PR is considered to be a very <clr> dirty trick<clrEnd>. It allows to effectively blacken your opponent in the eyes of other races. There is some risk though that everything will get revealed, and in this case you can lose the support of a considerable part of your voters. I will summon the dirty reporter here, meanwhile you think whom he attack, and whether this is necessary to do at all.

So, in whose eyes do you wish to blacken Abu Linkoln Husseyn this time?
loc.38.0:
Three experts were waiting for you in the adjacent room. You shook hands with them and sat down at a round table. Placing a pile of papers in front of himself, one of the experts said:

- We will be building up your election campaign in the interactive mode. For this, all we will need is to figure out the details of your ideas, and the computer will process a manifesto of them using an official protocol. If we may, we would like to ask you some questions regarding your policies as a potentially future president of <ToPlanet>.

- OK, - you responded.

- Then, the first question: <clr>what will be your policy concerning taxation?<clrEnd>

loc.39.1: - You mean, the protests of rights activists concerning the illegitimacy of the pregnancy tax will still be ignored?
loc.39.2: - You mean, the quarterly tax covering budget deficit will remain in force?
loc.39.3: - So, I gather that the specific tax for maintaining the struggle with the Dominators will not be abandoned?

loc.40.2: - Are you worried about the drop of the tax collection?

loc.40.4: - Will it cause a negative reaction of the population?

Either I didn't have enough money, or the chief refused to sell the idol, or some other nasty thing occurred... What would you advise me to do in this situation?

- Karra Bbach, <clr>Unconventional Situations Civil Defence<clrEnd> stereo-program. Imagine that you are returning to your planet after a knock-down-drag-out fight. Ship's body is damaged, the droid is broken, the forcefield is down, and only one of the five cannons is still firing. And when you are just about to enter your home system a pirate approaches you and demands payment for passing. What will be your actions in this situation?
loc.52.0: - Fine! Now I would like to hear more about each particular area. What are you planning to do to increase <clr>the military strength<clrEnd> of <ToPlanet>?
loc.53.0: - Interesting decision! And what are you planning to do in regards to the <clr>law enforcement<clrEnd>?
loc.54.0: - I hope that these steps will prove effective! And what will be your policy towards <clr>media freedom<clrEnd>?

- Od-dalani Tall Mud, <clr>"Lynching Pseudo-Science"<clrEnd> Journal. Tell me, do you believe in God?

- Sergeant Barrack, <clr>Service Routine<clrEnd> Wallpaper. Tell me, what are you normally doing to keep fit?

- Hush Baba, <clr>Law and how to dodge it<clrEnd> stereo-program. In order to open your own business on <ToPlanet>, you have to obtain a permit from the Mayor's office, police, firemen, health care organisation, chamber of commerce, environmental board, infrastructure committee and the head of the local mafiosi. Imagine that you have just 1000 cr for all that. Whom will you bribe first?
